mail/mbox_store#

An mbox file changed in place, under a lock.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let session = Mbox(Path("archive.mbox")).session();
defer session.close();
let added = session.add(record);
let removed = added.remove(added.messages().first()::Mail::identifier);

Description#

An mbox file changed in place, under a lock.

session() locks archive.mbox.okkama-mbox.lock and fails at once when another holds it. Each change checks the file still holds what was read (MboxConflict otherwise), writes a private temporary file and renames it over the old one. Ids stay valid within one session, not across reopening. The file must exist.
